semantic.justification: Task171 implements the complete native SfxStyleSheetIterator dependency of SfxStyleSheetBasePool: original search flags/default All, Used separation and predicate call order, all-family/family/predicate count/index/next paths, exact UTF16 name lookup, live index observations and cursor transitions. Reuses actual IndexedStyleSheets; erased borrowed native pool GetIndexedStyleSheets and style GetName/GetFamily/GetMask/IsUsed/IsHidden operations neither instantiate nor replace full style/pool owners. Native operator[] binds to at, vector bounds errors to RangeError and reference identities to GC-owned JS values. Preserve disabled visibility expression (CALC147), Find primary-position versus family Next mismatch (CALC148) and native fast-path uint16 narrowing (CALC149). No memory manager, C++ generator/probe, fake completed pool or broad module parity claim.
